newsitem.title: USA: Vision-Sciences gets OK for bronchoscope.
newsitem.headline: Vision-Sciences gets OK for bronchoscope.

text.p: Vision-Sciences Inc said Thursday it has received 510K marketing clearance for its fiberoptic bronchoscope and EndoSheath system.
The bronchoscope is considered particularly well suited for pulmonary cases involving highly infections or immuno-suppressed patients, the company said.

Vision-Sciences said the device is used in hospitals and is not expected to face the reimbursement obstacles with the Health Care Finance Administration that the company encountered with its sigmoidoscope sheath.
The agency has not approved reimbursement for the sigmoidoscope, the company said.

As a result, Vision-Sciences said it has decided to reduce sales and marketing costs by marketing its disposable EndoSheath, reusable flexible endoscope systems through a distributor network rather than through direct sales.
